name: Atha
text: Atha is a stately hall of the tale of the poet of the old romances. In the poem of the year 1760, the name marks the palace of the king named Cairbre. The writer sets the house in the west of the land and in the north. He places it on the bank of the great lake. Atha keeps its note in the pages of the modern fiction for the reader to find.

attributes.attribute: palace of the king in the tale of the poet Macpherson

okr.objective: Record the hall of the tale.
key_results: Name the palace of the king.
Set the hall by the lake.
